1.consolidated_definition: "Desyerbar con machete": acción y efecto de cortar o eliminar malezas o vegetación utilizando un machete.
1.en_consolidated_definition: To machete weeds or vegetation: action and effect of cutting or eliminating unwanted plants using a machete.
